item.title: This startup wants to make chicken cheaper in Nigeria with a simple solution
item.description: Cubeseed Africa wants to cut out middlemen and bring structure to Nigeria’s ₦900 billion poultry market. With escrow payments, credit partnerships, and 4,000+ farmers onboarded, it aims to make chicken cheaper and farmers more profitable.

item.title: A Lagos high court ruling puts Nigeria’s GSI process on trial
item.description: The GSI was built to kill bad loans, but is it killing due diligence? A Lagos High Court awarded ₦2m to a student in a loan recovery case against Fidelity Bank. Here's what it tells us about the CBN's GSI framework.
